deprecation.reason: This schema is now deprecated, in favor of the IEEE 1752.1 schema of the same name.

description: This schema represents an amount (value) of kilocalories (unit of measure).

references.description: The unit of measure of the element. The allowed value is kcal. This is not a standard (see http://unitsofmeasure.org/ucum.html#para-43), but it is the one commonly and widely used.
